'''Evan''' (Japanese: '''ジュンジ''' ''Junji'') is a recurring character in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}.

==History==
==={{MangaArc|Yellow}}===
[[File:Evan younger Adventures.png|thumb|left|170px|Evan before he became a {{tc|Camper}}]]
Evan debuted in ''[[PS050|Lapras Lazily]]'' in a flashback. After witnessing {{adv|Blue}} catching a wild {{p|Lapras}}, Evan appeared and demanded that he give it to him, as he was hoping to catch it first. When Blue refused, Evan admitted he only wanted Lapras so he'd have something to help find his missing {{p|Haunter}} that flew to the towards the {{FB|Kanto|Power Plant}} and never returned. After Blue agreed to help, he and Evan traveled to the Power Plant.

In ''[[PS051|Electro Magneton]]'', Evan and Blue encountered [[Agatha]] of the [[Elite Four]]. Agatha had lured various gas Pokémon to the Power Plant so she could catch them, Evan's Haunter included. During their battle, Agatha had her {{TP|Agatha|Gengar}} trap Blue in a coffin that slowly sapped his energy. With words of encouragement from Blue, Evan managed to find his Haunter and had it face Gengar. This distracted Gengar long enough for Blue to break out and defeat Agatha's Pokémon, forcing her to flee. Afterward, Blue thanked Evan for his help and released Lapras so Evan could do whatever he wanted with it.

Two years later, in ''[[PS064|Putting It on the Line...Against Arcanine]]'', Evan was revealed to have become a {{tc|Camper}}. After {{adv|Yellow}} arrived on [[Cinnabar Island]], she met Evan while he was gathering stones littered on the ground. Evan used the stones and his Pokémon to help {{adv|Blaine}} train with {{adv|Mewtwo}}. Once their training session ended, Blaine thanked Evan and paid him for his efforts.

In ''[[PS076|Take a Chance on Chansey]]'', Evan looked after the [[Cinnabar Gym]] while Blaine was away. He kept check on {{adv|Miles}}, a {{tc|Super Nerd}} hired by Agatha that Yellow defeated a few weeks prior. 

In ''[[PS083|Bang the Drum, Slowbro]]'', the Cinnabar Gym was attacked by a multitude of {{type|Dragon}} Pokémon commanded by the Elite Four. Evan and Miles kept themselves hidden while they waited for Yellow and the [[Gym Leader]]s to defeat the Elite Four.

==={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}===
In ''[[PS153|Oh, It's Ho-Oh!]]'', Evan and Miles entered in the Pokémon League. As they had no Gym Badges, they had to take part in the preliminary rounds. Due to the [[Masked Man]]'s attack on the [[Indigo Plateau]], the tournament was canceled and they never got a chance to compete.

==={{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}===
In ''[[PS295|Double Down Deoxys]]'', Evan and Miles were seen visiting Blaine at the Cinnabar Gym.
